query:
SELECT pp.productId, p.name, pp.channelId, sc.name as channelName, pp.price 
FROM productPrices pp 
JOIN products p ON pp.productId = p.id 
JOIN salesChannels sc ON pp.channelId = sc.id 
LIMIT 20
